title: WallsFromLayer Command
description: Extrude closed curves on a plan layer to wall solids. Nested room outlines become wall bands (outer minus inner). Does not create a roof, ceiling, or floor slab. Source curves are left untouched.

height.description: Extrusion height in document units (mm). Default 3000. Stamped on each wall as forsk:height.

target_layer.description: Layer for new solids. Created if missing. Default A-WALL.

name_prefix.description: Name prefix for new solids (wall-01, wall-02, …).

join_tolerance.description: Join tolerance for open segments. Default is max(10× model tolerance, 1).

apply_default_materials.description: If true, assign plaster (M-PLASTER) to the target layer and set objects By Layer. Default true.
